links.comparator_used: Fully manual contouring of volumes of interest by radiation oncologists (the abstract does not report a fully automatic, uncorrected arm)
links.outcome: Contouring time and inter-observer agreement (relative volume differences and similarity indices), plus clinician satisfaction
links.effect: Median time was 25.0 min (range 8.0-115.0) for manual delineation, versus 2.3 min (1.2-8) for DL segmentation plus 10.0 min (0.3-46.3) for manual corrections; the time difference was p<0.001. Satisfaction was 44% vote 4 and 43% vote 5, correlated with time saved (p<0.001). Manually adjusted DL-based VOIs showed better inter-agreement than manually segmented ones.
links.tradeoff: Manual correction of the DL contours was still needed, with a median of 10 min and up to 46.3 min per case. The abstract does not report any other cost or new error.
links.quote: The overall time for VOIs retrieving and modification was statistically significantly lower than for manual contouring (p<0.001).

design_hint: independent local validation with clinician correction of auto-contours before implementation
